description_en: Sends a DataChannel message to an agent call
description_zh: 向智能体通话发送DataChannel消息
name: SendAIAgentDataChannelMessage

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the agent that is currently in a call.

InstanceId is the unique ID returned after the agent instance is successfully started. For more information about the API operations used to start an agent, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846201.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846209.html
parameters.help_zh:
当前正在通话的智能体实例ID。

InstanceId为智能体实例启动成功后，返回的唯一的Id。启动智能体接口，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846201.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846209.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The DataChannel message to send. The value must be a JSON string with a maximum length of 8,192 characters
parameters.help_zh: 需要发送的datachannel消息。需要传入JSON字符串。字符串长度不超过8192
parameters.name: message
